summary_en: Hisaka Works executed a block purchase of 300,000 shares (1.14% of outstanding shares) at 1,641 yen per share on November 16, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3, for a total of approximately 492.3 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Block Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 16, 2026, Hisaka Works executed a block purchase of treasury stock via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours block trading) at 8:45 a.m. The company purchased 300,000 shares at a fixed price of 1,641 yen per share, representing 1.14% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) and totaling approximately 492.3 million yen. This execution was conducted as a single off-hours transaction with a firm order quantity matching the purchase amount, with results disclosed upon completion of the trading session.

This block purchase was executed under the discretionary scope of a broader authorization approved by the board of directors on the same date, which permits the company to acquire up to 1 million shares (3.80% of outstanding shares) for up to 2 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 16, 2026 and March 31, 2027. Prior to November 13, 2026, no shares had been acquired under this authorization.
